edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed by the parties in a writing signed by both parties (the “Settlement Amount”), within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date. The parties have not yet agreed on the Settlement Amount; no payment obligation arises unless and until they do so in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and their respective officers, directors, employees, and agents, releases and forever discharges Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and their respective officers, directors, employees, and agents from all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, and damages, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the claims asserted or that could have been asserted in the action through the Effective Date. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep confidential the existence and terms of this Agreement and information exchanged solely for settlement discussions, and shall not disclose them to any person except its attorneys, accountants, insurers, and other professional advisers who are bound to keep them confidential, or as required by law, court order, or applicable regulatory process. A party making a legally required disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment. These obligations do not apply to information that becomes public through no breach of this Agreement or was lawfully known to the receiving party without a duty of confidentiality. Each party is responsible for compliance by its representatives.
